english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a newly forming plant leaf or flower.
This is the all-purpose choice for a small new plant growth or a just-germinated young plant.

examples.english: A bud has just grown on the branch.
examples.traditional: 條樹枝上面啱啱生咗一粒芽。
